description: It reads the questions participants asked in the live console, the open ones and the answered ones, each with its id, the text, the name of the attendee, the time and the state. Take it when a host wants to know what people are asking or which questions are still waiting. "Are there questions I did not answer yet?" You give the webinar id and how many questions you want back. The ids come from this answer, so the next step can answer one or delete one without guessing. It changes nothing. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: live questions, open questions, attendee questions, Q and A

limit.description: How many questions to return, 1-200. Default 50.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.

name: wi_get_webinar_questions
title: Read the questions of the live webinar
